terms.noKill: No keeping — catch and release only (no-kill)
terms.ineffective: Not in force: the general regulations or the organization's rules are stricter.

org.title: Fishing rules
org.lead: The general regulations (the ordinance on fishing) always apply. The organization's and the water's rules can only make them stricter — of several values the strictest applies.
org.listTitle: Rules of the organization and its waters
org.empty: The organization has no rules of its own — the general regulations apply.

form.limitHint: Empty field — no limit; 0 — no keeping (no-kill).

minLength.label: Minimum size (cm)
minLength.error: Enter a whole number from 1 to 300.

closed.hint: Month and day, e.g. 01-01 and 04-30. The period may span New Year (12-01 – 02-28); the end of February is 02-28.
closed.error: Enter an existing day in MM-DD format; the period needs both dates.

dailyCount.label: Daily limit (fish)
dailyCount.error: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.

dailyWeight.label: Daily limit (grams)
dailyWeight.error: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100,000.

form.nothing: A rule must restrict something: fill in at least one field.

water.title: Fishing rules
water.lead: The strictest of the general regulations and the water's rules. The register checks catches against them.
water.empty: No specific species rules for this water.
